recap.analyst:
Guanabara FC beat Lombardia Nord 4-0. On expected goals it finished 0.31–0.56: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Lombardia Nord had 60% of the ball. Pass completion LOM 80% (171/213), GUA 75% (97/129). Shots 3–5, on target 0–3.

Lombardia Nord started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Guanabara FC in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: LOM to 3-4-3 at 68' (chasing the game); GUA to 4-4-2 at 81' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 5': Guanabara FC broke the deadlock through N. Chalaine. Score now LOM 0-1 GUA. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: T. Djedele completed the most passes (30); K. Hartvik hit the top speed (33.7 km/h); N. Chalaine covered the most ground (6.21 km, a 17.4 km per-90 pace); N. Chalaine won the most challenges (14).

Discipline: fouls 5–6, yellows 3–2, reds 0–1, offsides 0–1. Conditions: overcast, 21°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: What a game at Arena Lombarda, Milan. N. Chalaine broke the deadlock in the 5th minute. N. Chalaine struck in the 11th for Guanabara FC. Then an own goal in the 17th gave Guanabara FC another. P. Djedele struck in the 23rd for Guanabara FC. And the red card changed everything. Lombardia Nord pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 68th minute, but Guanabara FC held firm. The hero: N. Chalaine, with 2 goals. At the final whistle, Guanabara FC celebrate in front of their fans.
